body.p: In the beginning the hazel grouse was big, it was bigger than an elk. Once God was going. God was startled by the hazel grouse. After it had startled God, he cut the hazel grouse's meat, God took some of its meat. He shared the hazel grouse's meat with all creatures. Therefore, the hazel grouse has become small now.
